remarks: Welcome to your new home! This delightful 1-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom townhouse perfectly blends comfort and convenience. With ceilings soaring over 20 feet, you'll love the spacious feel of this unique space. The primary bedroom features a beautiful vintage skylight, letting in plenty of natural light and adding a special touch to your retreat. The recently updated bathrooms bring a modern flair, while the kitchen is complete with stainless steel appliances that make cooking a breeze. Step outside to your sun-filled balcony, the ideal spot to soak up the sun with your morning coffee or unwind with a good book in the afternoon. Location is everything and you couldn't ask for a better one! Just a short stroll from downtown SONO where you'll find fantastic restaurants and entertainment options to suit every taste. Your evenings will be filled with fun and delightful experiences. Commuting to the Big Apple? The Metro North train station is within walking distance, making your daily trips to New York City a breeze. For those sunny days, Calf Pasture Beach is one of Connecticut's top coastal spots and is just a quick drive away. Imagine spending your weekends relaxing on the shore and enjoying the beautiful coastline. This townhouse offers the comfort you crave and access to a vibrant community. Your dream rental is right here. Don't miss out on this opportunity to enjoy the best of coastal living and city convenience!
